sections.label: What he evaluates
sections.title: Four questions <t>a marina case turns on.</t>
sections.lede: Opinions on how a marina is expected to be designed, maintained and run, and whether it was.

cards.label: Operations
cards.title: Was the marina run to standard?
cards.desc: Operating procedures, staffing, inspections and maintenance programs, measured against how well-run marinas operate.

cards.label: Docks and structures
cards.title: Was the dock built and kept safe?
cards.desc: Floating dock systems, boat launching facilities, bulkheads, materials, elevations and long-term maintenance.

cards.label: Safety and compliance
cards.title: Did it meet the codes and standards?
cards.desc: Safety programs and compliance with OSHA standards, FEMA requirements and applicable maritime regulations, as listed on his website.

cards.label: Causation
cards.title: What happened, and why?
cards.desc: Accident reconstruction from photographs, video and the configuration of the dock, and opinions on causation and liability exposure.
